scope: Track A core (rule-based); LLM-grounded and Track B descoped
components: scene_graph_builder (deterministic context; scene type inferred from predicted labels)
tagger_type: spectral matched-filter, 1.0s window / 0.5s hop; deliberate PoC deviation from plan-required CLAP/PANNs; NO pretrained audio-model weights
threshold_tuning: validation label-count sweep in results/best_threshold.json selected 0.10; that value is a snapshot, not the runtime filter (0.15)
structured_context: deterministic text from predicted timeline; scene type inferred from detected labels (GT scenario not leaked)
rule_based_qa: keyword/intent classification + direct timeline computation (counting, temporal, causal from CAUSAL_TABLE, negation, comparative, perceptual)
tests: end-to-end tagging on real 16kHz WAV scenes; metrics produced by src/eval/run_eval.py
run_runnable: audio_path -> timeline -> context -> answer runs end-to-end
limitations: ESC-50/UrbanSound8K not downloaded; CLAP/PANNs not used; LLM-grounded answerer not implemented
